Brush JavaScript/WebAssembly runtime.
Built from ArthurBrussee/brush compatibility commit 3b80985709e2ec04fd6c8622a40e36473647a8e0.
360GS extension: v0.3c10 late train-view fit diagnostic before adaptive stopping.
Optimization and Gaussian growth behavior are unchanged from v0.3c9.
The first late train-fit metric is aligned with the minimum adaptive-stop boundary for each device plan.
Adaptive stopping waits until training-view and held-out PSNR/SSIM are both available at the same boundary.
SH degree remains 0 so the next quality change can be selected from evidence rather than confounded changes.
wasm-opt disabled in CI because --converge exceeded hosted-runner time limits.
